## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, the result format or the threshold syntax changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated for any user-visible change
- [ ] If existing behaviour changes, it is listed under "Changed" or "Fixed" with a note
- [ ] Japanese docs (`*_jp.md`) updated, or noted here that only the English version was updated
